content.text: Employee SSID - provides secure credentialed WiFi for Employees to their respective agency resources at their home base
NCGovRoam SSID - provides state employees credentialed access to WiFi at DIT WLAN service locations when employees are not at their home base
NCGov Guest SSID - provides seamless guest access at DIT WLAN service locations via uncredentialed CAP WAP access

content.description: Network architecture diagram showing WiFi authentication and routing for Guests and State Employees.
content.caption: Diagram illustrates connections from Guests and State Employees via NCGov Guest, Employee, and NCGovRoam SSIDs to Internet Access, Agency Networks, and the State Network. It details AP management routing to OOB Management (XiQ) and User Authentication Requests routing to the Data Center (Enterprise AD, NCID, and Policy Servers). SSIDs noted: Employee - hidden, NCGovRoam - broadcast, NCGov Guest - broadcast. VLANs & Subnets noted: Employee - 210, agency; NCGovRoam - 410, guest; NCGov Guest - 410, guest.
